profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Meta. Bachelors in Computer Science at Purdue University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Engineered a real-time data streaming API service utilizing C++ and Kafka, providing subscribed clients with over 40 million messages a day.
• Developed system architecture and implementation for a universal API service to process subscription requests across multiple products. Published data to Kafka and relational databases.
• Technical lead on a RESTful settings service project, built with C++ and MySQL. Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements. Designed for reusability with other teams and adaptability to existing data. Reduced time and effort to deploy new settings by ~80%.
• Implemented multiple key features for high-performance rate limiting library using C++ and Redis, including an asynchronous processing loop for massively increased rate-limiting throughput. Built for use across distributed systems, and fault tolerant to Redis disconnects/failures. Collaborated with multiple teams to assist with integration of the library.
• Designed reusable library and project template for building C++ pub/sub services utilizing internal frameworks, standardizing usage and reducing setup times for new services.
• Integrated crucial logging and metrics into multiple services for health and stability monitoring.
• Built automated docker testing environment with robust test cases for mentioned services.
• Mentored multiple interns and new-hires, providing knowledge sharing, guidance, and support.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Redis · kafka · Distributed Systems · Data Pipelines · Software Architecture · Apache Kafka · REST APIs · Containerization · Software Systems · Docker · Databases · Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Data Streaming · Communication · SQL · Fault Tolerant Systems · Software Design · Gtest · API Development · Software Infrastructure · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Implemented a generic rate limiting library with C++ and Redis for use in client facing endpoints.
• Created rate limiting algorithm capable of handling over 30,000 requests per second, per Redis cache with microsecond accuracy. 
• Allowed for enhanced configuration such as support for multiple Redis caches, and per key rate limits. 
• Wrote extensive test cases utilizing Google Test. 
• Utilized proprietary CI/CD pipeline to speed up deployment and testing.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Redis · Software Systems · Communication · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to Parliament, an Open Source “triple store” database for RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
• Increased productivity and maintainability of server code. Replaced legacy implementation with Spring Boot. 
• Developed REST APIs to cover SPARQL endpoint specifications. Used Java with Spring. 
• Improved existing exception handling control flow and error responses to failed queries.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · API Development · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · REST APIs · SPARQL

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supervise and assist students in understanding problems they face learning the fundamentals of C (CS240). Work alongside other teaching assistants to facilitate student learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Refactored Python program handling machine learning processes using Pandas and NumPy. Refactor focused on algorithmic improvements and encapsulation. Wrote test cases covering over 90% of refactored code. Collaborated with other team members in a SAFe Agile development Environment.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Imaged several hundred school machines.  Repaired machines with screen, RAM, base and keyboard replacement.  SSO portal bug testing on multiple operating systems.

honors.title: 2nd Place - Boilermake VIII Hackathon - Justifi
honors.description: Wrote backend for video discussion based social media platform (Justifi), with Express.js and MongoDB. Developed REST APIs for all user account features, per user video feeds via ML derived interests based on user interaction, and video uploading and streaming with Cloudflare Stream. Collaborating on a team of 3.

honors.title: 3rd Place - Boilermake VII Hackathon - AdventurousSloth
honors.description: Wrote backend for website (AdventurousSloth) which chooses your travel location based on questionnaire and builds itinerary with real information including flight bookings, hotel bookings, and local attractions. Developed REST APIs using Express.js and Node.js, using external APIs to pull relevant travel data. Worked on a team of 4, out of over 100 original teams.

projects.title: DubbClub (dubb.club)
projects.description: Developed website offering users sports data and predictions. Followed Agile process in team of five. Created REST APIs for user features including registration and login, live updates via SMS and email, and per game predicted winner voting. Built with Express.js, MongoDB, Twilio, and JWTs. Implemented endpoints for the EPL including live game statistics, team statistics and team standings.

projects.title: FINEX (finex.money)
projects.description: Contributed to website offering users financial and stock tools. Followed Agile process in team of six. Created REST APIs with Express.js and Node.js, developing features including simulated stock portfolio, safe budget management tools, and fast stock/crypto autocomplete. Built secure user accounts and authentication using Passport.js and MongoDB.

organizations.name: Purdue Autonomous Robotics Club
organizations.description: Purdue ARC focuses on building and developing a variety of robots and related software which can function autonomously to perform assigned tasks.
